content.title: Which stores will be open or closed on Easter Sunday 2026? Here's the full list
content.text: While many retailers scale back their hours or close entirely for the holiday, a number of major retail and restaurant chains will keep their doors open. WASHINGTON — Easter Sunday falls on April 5 this year, and if the holiday arrives and you're scrambling for last-minute groceries, a quick pharmacy run or just need to grab something on the go, knowing which stores will be open — and which won't — can save you a trip. While many retailers scale back their hours or close entirely for the holiday, a number of major retail and restaurant chains will keep their doors open. Here's what you need to know before you head out. Which stores are closed on Easter? These grocery stores and other retailers will close all locations to observe the holiday. Maxx What is open on Easter Sunday? Some of these stores will be open on Easter for reduced hours, but individual locations may be closed. Check with individual locations for specific store and pharmacy hours. 7-ElevenAlbertson'sBarnes & NobleBass Pro ShopsBig LotsBJ's WholesaleBurger KingCVSCracker BarrelDollar GeneralDomino'sDunkin’Family DollarFood LionGiant EagleGolden CorralHarris TeeterHome DepotIHOPIKEAKroger (stores include Baker’s, City Market, Dillons, Food 4 Less, Foods Co, Fred Meyer, Fry’s, Gerbes, Jay C Food Store, King Soopers, Kroger, Mariano’s, Metro Market, Pay-Less Super Markets, Pick’n Save, QFC, Ralphs, Ruler, Smith’s Food and Drug)LidlMcDonald’sMeijerPetcoPetSmartSafewayStarbucksTaco BellTrader Joe'sWalgreensWalmartWegman'sWendy'sWhole Foods Is Target open on Easter? No, all Target stores will be closed on Easter 2026. Is Walmart open on Easter? Yes, Walmart stores are open on Easter Sunday for 2026. Is Costco open on Easter? No, Costco is not open on Easter 2026. Easter Sunday is one of the seven holidays that Costco closes its U.S. warehouses. Is Sam's Club open on Easter? No, Sam's Club will be closed on Easter. Is Macy's open on Easter? No, Macy's will be closed on Easter. Is T.J. Maxx open on Easter? No, T.J. Maxx and other stores part of the TJX company, including HomeGoods and Marshalls, will be closed on Easter. Is Kohl's open on Easter? No, Kohl's will be closed on Easter. Is Kroger open on Easter? Yes, most stores owned by Kroger should be open their normal hours on Easter, but may have reduced hours. The Kroger Co. Family of Stores includes Baker’s, City Market, Dillons, Food 4 Less, Foods Co, Fred Meyer, Fry’s, Gerbes, Jay C Food Store, King Soopers, Kroger, Mariano’s, Metro Market, Pay-Less Super Markets, Pick’n Save, QFC, Ralphs, Ruler and Smith’s Food and Drug. Is Aldi open on Easter? No, Aldi will be closed on Easter. Is Trader Joe's open on Easter? Yes, most Trader Joe's locations will be open on Easter. Confirm hours with your individual location. Is Whole Foods open on Easter? Yes, Whole Foods will be open on Easter. Is CVS open on Easter? Is Walgreens open on Easter? Yes, Walgreens will be open Easter Sunday but hours will vary by location.
